summary: The Fairbanks court opened eight criminal cases on Nov. 15, seven of them arraigned the same afternoon. They include a Class B felony robbery charge and two Class C felony assault charges, and two cases in which the charge filed in court is lower than the charge police recorded on the arrest: a reported first-degree armed robbery filed as robbery in the second degree, and a reported felony assault filed as a single misdemeanor count. Troopers also reported a drunk-driving arrest after a vehicle went into the ditch on Farmers Loop, a shots-fired call at a Fairbanks residence and a hit and run off Echo Acres, the last two with no arrest. The Alaska Court System's weekly report of criminal cases filed closed its window on Nov. 14, so the court counts below are the report's own counts for that window and do not include the eight cases opened on Nov. 15. Both daily police feeds routinely add entries to past dates, so the figures here are the figures as of this reading rather than totals for the day.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Patrick Miller
body: Patrick Miller, 32, is charged with driving under the influence at a blood alcohol level of .08 or more, and with endangering the welfare of a minor in the first degree. Both are Class A misdemeanors on the court file. The second charge covers driving under the influence with a child in the vehicle.
Troopers say they responded to the area of Farmers Loop in Fairbanks on Nov. 15 for a vehicle in the ditch, arrested him, and took him to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. Alaska State Troopers.
Case 4FA-26-02295CR. He was arraigned Nov. 15; a pre-trial conference is set for Dec. 31.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 15

entries.title: Shots fired at a Fairbanks residence
body: Troopers say they responded to a residence in Fairbanks over a report of shots fired and found several shotgun shells and handgun casings at the scene. No damage was reported, and troopers say the complainant believes the suspect is known to him.
No arrest has been made and no one has been charged. The investigation is continuing. Alaska State Troopers.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 15

entries.title: Hit and run reported off Echo Acres
body: Troopers say they received a report of a hit and run at a residence off Echo Acres in Fairbanks on Nov. 15. The investigation is continuing and no arrest has been made.
Troopers ask anyone with information to call them in Fairbanks at 907-451-5100, and say the call can be anonymous.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 15

entries.title: Robbery charge: Michael Aaron Tritt
body: Michael Aaron Tritt, 52, is charged with robbery in the second degree — using force to take property or prevent resistance — a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years. He is also charged with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury, a Class A misdemeanor.

According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 1500 block of Lacey Street in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 11:27 p.m. The police bulletin records the arrest charge as robbery in the first degree, armed with a deadly weapon; the charge filed in court is robbery in the second degree.
Case 4FA-26-02293CR. He was arraigned Nov. 15; preliminary hearings are set for Nov. 25 and Dec. 3.

entries.title: Felony assault charge: Justin Long
body: Justin Long, 26, is charged with assault in the third degree — causing physical injury with a dangerous instrument — a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. He is also charged with three counts of assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury, and one count of violating a court-ordered condition of release. The four assault counts are recorded on the court file as domestic violence related.

Troopers say they responded on Nov. 14 to a report of multiple assaults at a residence on Pheasant Drive and arrested him after an investigation, and that he was also served with an outstanding warrant for failure to appear.
Case 4FA-26-02294CR, offense location North Pole. He was arraigned Nov. 15; preliminary hearings are set for Nov. 25 and Dec. 3.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 15

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Sennet Mckenzie Sweat Claus
body: Sennet Mckenzie Sweat Claus, 27, is charged with four counts, all Class A misdemeanors and all recorded on the court file as domestic violence related: one count of assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury, and three counts of fourth-degree assault committed while a child was present.
According to Fairbanks Police, she was arrested at the 300 block of Driveway Street in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 10:56 p.m.
Case 4FA-26-02291CR. She was arraigned Nov. 15; a pre-trial conference is set for Jan. 14, 2027.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Michael John Deangelo Callahan
body: Michael John Deangelo Callahan, 30, is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, a Class A misdemeanor on the court file.
According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 100 block of College Road in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 10:51 p.m.
Case 4FA-26-02292CR. He was arraigned Nov. 15; a pre-trial conference is set for Jan. 14, 2027.

entries.title: Criminal trespass arrest: Logan Jeffery Lucas
body: Logan Jeffery Lucas, 32, was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining on another's premises — recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
According to Fairbanks Police, the arrest was at the 1600 block of East Cowles Street in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 11:24 p.m.
Case 4FA-26-02288CR. No charging document has been filed in the case yet, so the court record states no charge or charge class. Arraignment is set for Nov. 20.

entries.title: DUI and felony assault charges: Dominik Moore
body: Dominik Moore, 23, of Fairbanks, is charged with assault in the third degree — causing physical injury with a dangerous instrument — a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. He is also charged with driving under the influence at a blood alcohol level of .08 or more, and with driving without required liability insurance.

Troopers say they responded to a two-vehicle collision at Farmers Loop Road and Alexander Avenue in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at about 5:12 p.m., determined one of the drivers had been drinking, and took him to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. Troopers ask anyone who witnessed the collision to call them in Fairbanks at 907-451-5100.
Case 4FA-26-02290CR. He was arraigned Nov. 15; preliminary hearings are set for Nov. 25 and Dec. 3.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 14

entries.title: Assault charge: Melanie Lee Burtis
body: Melanie Lee Burtis, 45, is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing physical injury to another person — a Class A misdemeanor on the court file.

According to Fairbanks Police, she was arrested at the 1000 block of Lacey Street in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 4:15 p.m. The police bulletin records the arrest charge as assault in the third degree, a felony; the only charge filed in court is the misdemeanor count above.
Case 4FA-26-02289CR. She was arraigned Nov. 15; a pre-trial conference is set for Dec. 31.

entries.title: Resisting arrest: Michael Jamar Reynolds
body: Michael Jamar Reynolds, 32, is charged with resisting or interfering with arrest by force, and with giving false information as to identity when cited or served with a warrant. Both are Class A misdemeanors on the court file.

According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 500 block of Gaffney Road in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at 2:05 a.m. The police bulletin also records a disorderly conduct charge, which is not on the court file.
Case 4FA-26-02287CR. He was arraigned Nov. 14; a pre-trial conference is set for Jan. 14, 2027.

entries.title: Stolen vehicle recovered in Fairbanks traffic stop
body: Troopers say they stopped a Chevrolet Trailblazer near Coal Lane in Fairbanks on Nov. 14 at about 2:52 a.m. over an expired and partly damaged registration tab, and that a records check showed the vehicle had been reported stolen in Anchorage about a month earlier.

Troopers say the driver was detained and interviewed, that they found insufficient evidence she knowingly possessed a stolen vehicle, and that she was released while the investigation continues. The vehicle was seized and recovered. No one was charged, and the driver is not named here.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 15

entries.title: Court report: 44 criminal cases filed in Fairbanks-area courts in the week to Nov. 14
body: The Alaska Court System's weekly report of criminal cases filed ran on the night of Nov. 14 and covers Nov. 8 to Nov. 14. Inside the Fairbanks area it lists 44 cases: 39 at the Fairbanks court, four at Delta Junction, one at Nenana and none at Healy.
The report lists charges as filed. A person named in it has not been convicted, and charges can be amended or dismissed as a case goes on.
The report's window closed on Nov. 14, so it does not include the eight criminal cases the Fairbanks court opened on Nov. 15. Those eight are reported above and below from the court files themselves.
